definitions.rate: of a disease's train patients, the share in whom a listed evidence is positive
definitions.share_below_rare: list entries with a rate below 0.05
definitions.share_near_certain: list entries with a rate of at least 0.99
definitions.valued_pairs: pairs of a disease and a categorical or multi-choice evidence: how many are on the disease's list, how many listed ones every train record of the disease holds with some value, and how many unlisted ones no train record of the disease holds

definitions.listed: pairs of a patient and a categorical or multi-choice evidence on the gold disease's list
definitions.listed_not_recorded: of these, the pairs whose evidence the record does not hold with any value
definitions.recorded_not_listed: categorical or multi-choice evidences a record holds off the gold disease's list

definitions.gold_is_top: the gold disease has the largest probability of the reference differential (ties count)
definitions.mass_on_excluded: the share of the differential's probability on diseases whose list does not hold every positive evidence of the patient
